summary: Three outside hypotheses were audited and not run. The transfer search already tries two and three transfers. The pairs it skips were worth 0.06 a week on 2025/26. The same shadow on the three earlier seasons is queued, and a rewrite is rejected if each season stays under 0.25 with fewer than three weeks at or above 1. A clean previous-season fill on the fast eleven is the second test. A distribution around the same mean does not change the expected captain or the expected total, so that hypothesis stays parked. No engine change.
